title: Legacy Reforged+
body:
**What is the Legacy Reforged+ modpack?**

Legacy Reforged+ is an aesthetic and performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed for builders and world-creators who want to push their projects beyond the limits of the base game. It combines high-quality semi-realistic textures, expanded building options, and optimized performance mods for a smooth, immersive experience.

**What does it offer?**
- 🧱 Thousands of handcrafted blocks and decorative details
- 🌿 32x realistic textures with connected textures and rich detail
- 🌤️ Custom skies, lighting, and environmental effects for added atmosphere
- 🌾 Enhanced foliage, terrain layers, and natural realism


**Build. Refine. Reforge.**

From ancient ruins to medieval cities, Legacy Reforged+ gives you the tools to create worlds that feel alive, handcrafted, and steeped in history.
